facts.fact: La Nation states that article 576 of the Code du numerique provides five years' imprisonment and a FCFA 25 million fine for publishing online, without consent, a montage of a person's image or words whose artificial character is not evident or flagged.
La Nation reports that a learner prosecuted for circulating retouched photographs of his teacher was heard by the CRIET on 8 October 2026.
